name: customer-create-modal-autofill-polish
title: Fix customer create modal autofill and polish
description: Prevent manager credentials from being autofilled into the new-customer form and improve the modal hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive presentation.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Flow traced from Customer discriminator and user GraphQL mutations through useUserManagement to AddCustomerModal. Backend contracts are correct; the defect is browser/password-manager autofill caused by missing form field metadata. The branch is based on the latest main and inherits the current auth and smoke-test fixes instead of duplicating them.
